discovery_plan.phase: Step 1 — Confirm Dates, Then Re-Quote (rate snapshots checked Nov 27, 2026)
discovery_plan.action: Confirm trip length and city split. Then search Booking.com for the exact check-in/out dates and compare the same queen/king room with taxes/fees, cancellation deadline, prepayment, breakfast, and Genius/member eligibility visible. The captured prices are dynamic snapshots; some are nonrefundable, so do not assume booking is zero-risk or that a Black Friday price is the cheapest.

Confirm passport visa/entry rules; pick 4–8 priority MICHELIN restaurants; email/call hotel concierges (Park Plaza / Grand Millennium / Radisson Blu / Peninsula) to verify unpublished hours, seasonal RMB menu pricing, and booking opening dates for 3* Taian Table, 3* Xin Rong Ji, 3* Chao Shang Chao, 2* Canton 8, and 2* King's Joy.

Set up Alipay & WeChat Pay linked to international Visa/Mastercard; verify final 2027 Shanghai Metro fare table (post-Aug 2026 hearing); confirm Mutianyu cable car/toboggan 2027 tariffs and Feb 20 Lantern Festival timed-entry rules at Yuyuan.

discovery_plan.phase: Step 4 — 15 Days Before Travel (Late Jan / Early Feb 2027)
discovery_plan.action: Book Beijing South -> Shanghai Hongqiao Fuxing G-train tickets on 12306.cn the morning tickets open (post-Spring Festival return demand can sell out prime trains).

At 20:00 Beijing Time sharp, 7 days before your date, reserve Forbidden City (bookingticket.dpm.org.cn), Tian'anmen Square, National Museum of China, and Shanghai Museum East/West using exact passport numbers.

suggestions.title: Compare cancellation terms before deciding whether to hold a room
suggestions.idea: For the Feb 15–22 snapshot (2 adults, 7 nights), base-Beijing shows $453.20 nonrefundable or $490.20 with free cancellation; Park Plaza shows $795.13 on a Genius/member free-cancellation rate; Pullman Shanghai shows $659 nonrefundable or $750.89 with free cancellation. The Booking.com totals include taxes/fees; verify room, member eligibility, cancellation cutoff, and payment timing in the live checkout.
suggestions.tradeoff: The lowest displayed amount may be nonrefundable, while a flexible offer costs more; these are date-specific snapshots, not a promise of savings or a risk-free booking. Only reserve after exact dates and terms are confirmed.

suggestions.title: Tour Beijing FIRST (Feb 15–22) and Shanghai SECOND (Feb 22–Mar 1)
suggestions.idea: Feb 15–22 includes Lantern Festival (Sat Feb 20). Schedule major visits around verified opening days, then check current official notices for any event-related restrictions on central Beijing attractions. The sampled hotel prices and different rate plans do not establish that this is a universally cheapest stay window.
suggestions.tradeoff: Beijing in mid-Feb is colder than mid-March (pack thermal layers & windproof coat), though indoor museums/subways are well heated; check local notices for any event/security restrictions closer to travel.

suggestions.title: Consider Splitting or Picking Chaoyang If Fine Dining Outweighs Imperial Sights
suggestions.idea: Because Chaoyang holds 20/33 (60.6%) of Beijing’s MICHELIN stars vs Dongcheng’s 9/33 (27.3%), Grand Millennium (Feb 15–22: $880.19 nonrefundable / $890 free-cancellation) or Kempinski ($968 free-cancellation) places you near the Chaoyang dining cluster; Park Plaza ($795.13 Genius/member free-cancellation) and base-Beijing ($453.20 nonrefundable / $490.20 free-cancellation) favor Wangfujing/imperial-sight access. These Booking.com totals include taxes/fees and require a live re-check.
suggestions.tradeoff: Chaoyang adds ~20–30 min subway ride to Forbidden City; Dongcheng adds ~20–30 min subway ride to Chaoyang CBD/Sanlitun dinners.

suggestions.title: Use base-Beijing Wangfujing's In-Unit Washer & Kitchenette as Your Laundry Reset
suggestions.idea: The Feb 15–22 base-Beijing snapshot is $453.20 nonrefundable or $490.20 with free cancellation for a 53 m² (570 ft²) Exquisite Studio with queen bed, private kitchenette, and washing machine. This may help with laundry on a longer stay, but the captured 7-night rate cannot be multiplied into a 2–4 week quote.
suggestions.tradeoff: Serviced apartment format (no swimming pool or 5-star concierge desk; exact metro walk distance should be confirmed on booking).

suggestions.title: Pair High-Value MICHELIN Lunches with 1–2 Signature Tasting Dinners
suggestions.idea: Book 1* Yi Long Court's verified Dim Sum Lunch Set at The Peninsula Shanghai (CNY 596 base / CNY 694.94 all-in for 2), ¥¥ 2* Canton 8 in Shanghai, and ¥¥ 1* Poetry·Wine or The Beijing Kitchen in Beijing alongside your bucket-list 3* splurge.
suggestions.tradeoff: Preserves budget for 3* Xin Rong Ji / 3* Chao Shang Chao / 3* Taian Table without paying ¥¥¥¥ dinner tariffs every night.

suggestions.title: Use Shanghai Museum East (OPEN Mondays!) + Met Jewelry Exhibition as Your Monday Arrival Anchor
suggestions.idea: While Shanghai Museum West, Yu Garden, Da Vittorio, and Sir Elly's are closed Mondays, Shanghai Museum East in Pudong (Line 2) is OPEN Mondays and hosts the Met Museum co-curated 'Jewelry: The Body Transformed' show through 2027-05-05.
suggestions.tradeoff: Closes Tuesdays instead — keep Tuesday for People's Square West Museum & Yu Garden.

suggestions.title: Evaluate Suzhou/Hangzhou Day Trips or Xi'an/Chengdu Before Booking Open-Jaw Flights
suggestions.idea: For a 3–4 week trip, adding 1–2 rail day trips from Shanghai (Suzhou/Hangzhou) or a 4-night Xi'an/Chengdu loop adds huge geographic contrast without flying back and forth.
suggestions.tradeoff: IDEA ONLY — none of Suzhou, Hangzhou, Xi'an, or Chengdu have been verified yet; approve first before we run primary-source hotel/activity verification.
